scripts.build: npm run build -w @geograph/domain && npm run build -w @geograph/api && npm run build -w @geograph/web
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @geograph/api" "npm run dev -w @geograph/web"
scripts.test: npm run build -w @geograph/domain && npm run test -w @geograph/domain && npm run test -w @geograph/api && npm run test -w @geograph/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @geograph/domain && npm run typecheck -w @geograph/domain && npm run typecheck -w @geograph/api && npm run typecheck -w @geograph/web
